checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'offer-and-angle'.

checks.description: Produces the angle and offer_framing fields.
checks.rule: Output names both angle and offer_framing, matching the strategy-artifact body in handoff-contract.md.

checks.description: The angle carries a rationale tied to the segments.
checks.rule: The angle states the core message and why it works for the named segments and the offer, not just a slogan.

checks.description: Price is shown only when the brief supplies it.
checks.rule: Offer framing shows a price or promotion only when the brief provides it and the asset calls for it; an ASSUMPTION price is framed without a number and flagged, never invented.

checks.description: No invented offer, Skill Path title, instructor name, or accreditation.
checks.rule: The framing references only offers, prices, titles, and instructors traceable to the brief or context; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask, and no accreditation is implied.

checks.description: The angle relieves a named pain or creates a named gain tied to a specific segment.
checks.rule: A pains-and-gains pass precedes the angle, listing per-segment pains and gains drawn from the segment 'why' and context (never invented), and the angle's rationale relieves a named pain or creates a named gain for a specific segment.

checks.description: The offer framing names the competitive alternative and how the positioning beats it.
checks.rule: Offer framing includes an alternative field naming what the reader does instead today (free content on social, another app, or nothing) and states how the positioning beats it; the alternative is a real one, never a straw man or invented.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no U+0640 tatweel character appear in any file in this skill.

checks.description: The angle is empowering, not deficit-framed.
checks.rule: The angle speaks to what the reader can build, never to what they lack or should be ashamed of, per context/brand-voice.md.
